briefings.title: Mukesh Ambani Speech at AI Summit: Will Prove AI Doesn't Take Away Jobs, Creates New Ones | N18V

people.name: Mukesh Ambani
people.role: Chairman & Managing Director, Reliance Industries Limited

briefings.tldr: Mukesh Ambani, Chairman of Reliance Industries, announced a ₹10 lakh crore investment over seven years to transition India from the "internet era" to the "intelligence era," pledging to make AI as affordable and ubiquitous as mobile data while driving national development toward a "Viksit Bharat" by 2047.
